thread:
maria: Customer hit an error from the ranking endpoint. They sent a long query + ~220 docs and got a 413.

maria: Error body: "413 Payload Too Large - total_tokens=12500 limit=8192". Also saw a 422 variant in another repro.

alex: Can you paste the minimal repro (headers + body) or a curl?

maria: here's what they sent (redacted):
```
POST /v1/rank HTTP/1.1
Authorization: Bearer <redacted>
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "query": "<~8000 chars>...",
  "documents": ["<doc1>...", "<doc2>...", ... ~220 items]
}
```

sam: 220 docs is a lot for the reranker - our docs limit is around 200 with default token budgets depending on model. If each doc is long you blow past token limit quickly.

sam: quick triage checklist: 1) tokens per doc, 2) query length, 3) model variant (quantized vs full), 4) whether they used embeddings+rerank combo.

maria: Customer confused because API just returned 413 and the message doesn't say which field caused it (query vs docs vs count). They want clearer guidance.

alex: Agreed. We should return structured error details: {error_type, offending_field, max_allowed, actual_value}. e.g. "error_type": "input_size_exceeded", "offending_field": "documents_total_tokens".

jon_eng: tagging eng-runtime for visibility. @alex @sam, we already map some backend errors to 413. Can we include token counts in the mapped response safely (no PII)?

sam: token counts are fine. Don't echo doc text. Include aggregated metrics only.

support-bot: Created ticket #4567 and linked customer logs.

maria: Customer also asked for a client-side validator snippet to avoid this at call time. I drafted one:
```js
// pseudo: estimate tokens, limit = 8192
function estimateAndValidate(query, docs) {
  const est = estimateTokens(query) + docs.reduce((s,d) => s + estimateTokens(d), 0);
  if (est > 8192 || docs.length > 200) throw new Error('input_size_exceeded');
}
```

alex: Nice. For short-term, let's update support KB with: recommended max docs=200, recommended per-doc length=~2k chars, and show chunking pattern.

alex: For product fix, I'll open a small PR to change 413 mapper to return: 
{
  "error": "input_size_exceeded",
  "message": "Combined query+documents exceed token limit",
  "details": { "max_tokens": "8192", "provided_tokens": "<n>", "max_documents": "200", "provided_documents": "<n>" }
}

jon_eng: fine with that. Also add telemetry event so we can surface top offending fields.

maria: Customer accepted workaround (chunk + paginate docs + call rerank on subsets then merge). They asked for ETA.

alex: I'll file the PR today and aim for a patch release next week. I'll also update the KB draft.

maria: Thanks. I'll update the customer and attach the ticket.

sam: One more note — log shows they attempted to use embeddings endpoint then rerank with full doc bodies. Recommend storing embeddings server-side and only sending vectors when possible.

maria: Noted, will suggest that in reply. :thumbsup:

alex: assigning to myself for PR.

support-bot: Ticket #4567 updated: priority=high, assignee=alex.

jon_eng: Closing out our triage here. If you hit a non-413 variant (422), paste the raw body and I will trace mapping.

maria: Closing on this thread, will follow up if customer re-opens.
